---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Shrinkcage issue without private session contents
---

Describe the issue and expected behavior. Include the Shrinkcage version, operating system, Node version, affected connector, and reproduction steps.

Do not attach real session transcripts, prompts, credentials, private paths or unsanitized screenshots. Use a synthetic minimal record if a session format is involved. Report security issues privately as described in SECURITY.md.
